steps.title: Download TCGA raw counts
steps.instruction: Load the TCGAbiolinks package, query the GDC for TCGA‑LUAD STAR‑Counts, download the files into a folder named "GDCdata", and prepare a SummarizedExperiment object; then extract the clinical data frame. Expect approximately 540 tumor samples and 59 normal samples. Do NOT use TPM or FPKM as input for DESeq2 or edgeR.

substeps.instruction: query <- GDCquery(project = "TCGA-LUAD", data.category = "Transcriptome Profiling", data.type = "Gene Expression Quantification", workflow.type = "STAR - Counts")

steps.title: Decide normalization strategy
steps.instruction: Use raw, unnormalized counts directly as input for DESeq2 (which applies median‑of‑ratios internally). For downstream visualization, apply vst() after model fitting. If the data are RSEM expected counts, round them with round() before DESeq2. If you only have TPM/FPKM, return to the GDC and obtain raw counts.

steps.title: Create DESeq2 dataset
steps.instruction: Load DESeq2, set the random seed to 42, extract the unstranded count matrix and column metadata from the SummarizedExperiment, verify matching sample names, and build a DESeqDataSet with design ~ sample_type.

substeps.instruction: dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts_mat, colData = col_data, design = ~ sample_type)

steps.title: Pre‑filter lowly expressed genes
steps.instruction: Keep genes that have at least 10 counts in at least 5 samples (rowSums(counts(dds) = 10) = 5) and subset the DESeqDataSet accordingly.

steps.title: Set reference level and run DESeq2
steps.instruction: Relevel the factor sample_type so that "Solid Tissue Normal" is the reference, run the DESeq pipeline, and obtain results for the contrast Primary.Tumor vs Solid.Tissue.Normal with alpha = 0.05.

steps.title: Shrink fold changes and select DEGs
steps.instruction: Apply lfcShrink with the apeglm method, then subset genes with adjusted p‑value < 0.05 and absolute log2 fold change > 1, ordering them by padj. Expect 3,000‑5,000 DEGs at these thresholds.

steps.title: Map Ensembl IDs to gene symbols
steps.instruction: Load org.Hs.eg.db, strip version suffixes from Ensembl IDs, map them to HGNC symbols, add the symbols to the results object, and remove rows with NA symbols or duplicated symbols.

substeps.instruction: gene_symbols <- mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, keys = sub("\\..*", "", rownames(res)), keytype = "ENSEMBL", column = "SYMBOL", multiVals = "first")

steps.title: GO over‑representation analysis
steps.instruction: Load clusterProfiler, define the set of significant gene symbols (padj < 0.05 and |log2FC| > 1), and run enrichGO for Biological Process using BH adjustment and p‑value cutoff 0.05.

substeps.instruction: ego <- enrichGO(gene = sig_genes, OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db, keyType = "SYMBOL", ont = "BP", pAdjustMethod = "BH", pvalueCutoff = 0.05)

steps.title: Gene set enrichment analysis
steps.instruction: Create a named vector of log2 fold changes from the shrunken results, using gene symbols as names, sort it decreasingly, remove NA names and duplicated entries, and run gseGO with minGSSize 15, maxGSSize 500, pvalueCutoff 0.05, eps 0, and seed = TRUE. Do NOT pre‑filter the list before GSEA.

substeps.instruction: gsea_go <- gseGO(geneList = gene_list, OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db, keyType = "SYMBOL", ont = "BP", minGSSize = 15, maxGSSize = 500, pvalueCutoff = 0.05, eps = 0, seed = TRUE)

steps.title: GSVA pathway scoring
steps.instruction: Load GSVA and msigdbr, retrieve the Hallmark gene sets for Homo sapiens, split them into a list, obtain the vst‑transformed expression matrix (blind = FALSE), and compute GSVA scores using a Gaussian kernel. Expect a matrix of ~50 Hallmark pathways by number of samples.
